name: rentnaija
description: RentNaija - P2P Property Rental Platform for Nigeria

scripts.dev: concurrently "cd rentnaija-backend && npm run dev" "cd rentnaija-frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd rentnaija-backend && npm run build && cd ../rentnaija-frontend && npm run build
scripts.start: concurrently "cd rentnaija-backend && npm run start" "cd rentnaija-frontend && npm run start"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd rentnaija-backend && npm install && cd ../rentnaija-frontend && npm install
scripts.docker:build: cd rentnaija-backend && docker build -t rentnaija-backend . && cd ../rentnaija-frontend && docker build -t rentnaija-frontend .
scripts.test: cd rentnaija-backend && npm run test && cd ../rentnaija-frontend && npm run test
scripts.lint: cd rentnaija-backend && npm run lint && cd ../rentnaija-frontend && npm run lint

author: RentNaija Team
